title: Batch HTTPS link and redirect report for up to 20 URLs
description: Check up to 20 public HTTPS URLs independently. Reports final destination, redirect hops, HTTP response and elapsed request time. Errors are reported separately; timing is not a browser speed benchmark. Automatic processing of publicly accessible HTTPS URLs. JSON report with UTC observation time, observed HTTP status and redirect chain. One observation from one server; no JavaScript rendering, login, vulnerability testing or remediation. Up to 5 redirects and 256 KiB per page. GitHub worker checks orders approximately every 15 minutes; scheduling can be delayed. Acceptance window 24 hours; delivery allowance after acceptance 2 hours. On-delivery payment: preview first, pay through Agent Souk to reveal the complete report. Unprocessable new requests are declined without charge. AI-assisted development operated by Profix Code Operator.
